source_instruction: i'm looking for double sided hair extensions for hair care accessories.
query: Ugh, you won’t believe the mess I dealt with on my walk over here today! I stopped to grab an iced lavender latte from that little corner cart by the park entrance, and right as I was twisting the lid to take a sip, a huge, fluffy golden retriever came barrelling past chasing a squirrel, smacked right into my wrist, and sloshed coffee all down the front of my favorite light wash denim jacket. I had to duck into the public restroom by the playground to blot it as best I could with scratchy paper towels, and I swear half the people walking by stared like I’d somehow managed to roll in a mud puddle on a totally sunny day. By the time I got the worst of the sticky coffee splotch lifted enough that I didn’t look like a total mess, my latte was half gone and lukewarm, and I realized I’d also dropped the pack of honey lemon throat drops I’d bought for the tickle I’ve had in my throat since yesterday’s bonfire. Hey there, I’m browsing the hair coloring products section right now and I’m looking for hair extensions that are triple sided, could you help me out? I need to grab that one I always pick, the option I get every time I stop by for these. I don’t want to spend too much, so just make sure whatever you pull up fits what I’m comfortable paying for, yeah? I’d really appreciate it if you could point me to the right picks quick.
